routes.//: Vercel serves public/ straight from its CDN, so the Cache-Control set in server.js never reaches these files. Without this they went out with a 4 hour max-age, which left visitors running a stale bundle for hours after every deploy. max-age=0 with must-revalidate still allows the etag to answer 304, so this costs a conditional request rather than a re-download. Media keeps the default caching: those filenames are effectively immutable.
